verification.validation: Basic release gate (bash scripts/gate.sh) on macOS as a non-root account: docs, policy, version, protocol/admission limit and executor manifest checks, internal-content repo scan, Go vet/build (SDK and executor) and units (api, dsm, filestation, jsonlimits, identity), Node typecheck/units (34)/build, Python units, frontend gate (typecheck, 1440 units, build, packed consumer import, pack contents), package content scans. The gate ran from the worktree's real path with TMPDIR on a real path: macOS /tmp and /var are symlinks, and release-gate-plan's main-module check (and its dispatcher test) otherwise sees an empty plan. Both npm tarballs, raw and prepared by prepare-npm-publish.py, and the prepared directories scanned for internal content (generic rules; no private denylist set). No full gate, QEMU, executor rebuild, Rust build, crate publication or NAS acceptance.

changes: app.status answers in the caller's DSM display language: bootEntryPage reads the user's language on DSM's own origin with the page's session (SYNO.Core.UserSettings, else SYNO.Core.Region.Language when the user follows the system) and sends it as the dsmLanguage parameter; api.AppStatusHandler with a nil language uses that hint, else the user's last hint in this process (256 users), else the browser's Accept-Language. The backend never reads DSM with the browser's session. AppLanguage now receives the request, and a custom language error falls back to the browser (from #228).
Reuse executor 0.53.6 unchanged: executor sources and build inputs are unchanged.
